Env call order verified (IsaacLab direct_rl_env.py:388-398: episode_length_buf += 1, _get_dones, _get_rewards, then _reset_idx), so a reset env shows progress 1/900 below its last value and pays 0; drops terminate (pour_fabric_env.py _get_dones), no mid-episode cup teleport. Residuals: (a) first_out is not latched: bead_in_source_frac is instantaneous geometry (bead_flags.py), a bead poking past the rim and falling back sets first_out 1->0->1, and a tilt-up with first_out 1 / untilt with first_out 0 pays +25.0 per 30->80->30 deg cycle (104 steps) at W 0.5 (iter_23 +5.1). i23 traces: first_out rose 3 steps in 3/64 env at ep300, 0 at ep400-600, tilt_open on those env -1.4, so rare now. The notes' 94/episode cap holds only while first_out is monotone. (b) pre-existing symmetric clamp: slow-in/fast-out +33.5 aim+place vs -3.6 speed/spin per 56 steps (iter_23 +30.4); coaxial crossing +-5.5 (iter_23 +-5.4); regular closed loops at env dt: mean +0.017 (iter_23 +0.015). (c) pre-existing stage_cd gate: a 1-step grasp-flag flicker drops that step's difference (<= W_AIM+W_PLACE per flicker, ~4 flickers/env-episode at i23 ep600, untimed -> ~0). (d) validator dry run uses N=64 for all 3 seeds, so seeds 1-2 take differences between unrelated random contexts: validation.json magnitudes of aim/place/tilt_open mean nothing (finite, clamped). (e) one cache slot per loaded module: fine for one env per process; two same-N envs in one process would share it. (f) receiver already grips with ~3.5 non-thumb fingers, so change 2 adds +0.09..+0.12/step to the receiver and takes -0.05..-0.06/step from the 3-finger source (trace replay); ceiling unchanged.
